net.coobird.thumbnailator.tasks.io.OutputStreamImageSink sink = 
    new net.coobird.thumbnailator.tasks.io.OutputStreamImageSink(imageBytes);

java.io.OutputStream dest = sink.getDestination();

assert dest != null : "Destination should not be null";
assert dest == imageBytes : "Destination should match the provided OutputStream instance";

System.out.println("__CHECK__ getDestination " + (dest == imageBytes));
